name: SurveyJS Form Library Open Source
free_limit: Free MIT-licensed JavaScript library for embedding dynamic forms, multi-step surveys and quizzes in web applications; no vendor-imposed form or submission quotas in the open-source library.
watch_out: Form Library is a client-side renderer, not SurveyJS Cloud hosting or a response database. You must supply and operate your own backend/storage. Survey Creator, PDF Generator and Dashboard are separate paid proprietary products; do not assume their developer licenses are included.
